content.user_title: Build Google ADK Agents with agents-cli
content.value_statement: ADK agent projects require many linked steps across scaffolding, testing, deployment, and operations. This skill gives a staged agents-cli workflow that helps coding agents follow those steps consistently.
actual_capabilities: Guides requirements capture, spec writing, and scaffold decisions before code is written.
Maps common Google agent platform terms to supported agents-cli flags.
Directs reference sample review from google/adk-samples before implementation.
Recommends agents-cli commands for running, evaluating, deploying, publishing, and observing agents.
Provides code preservation, model selection, debugging, and environment variable guidance.
Links related companion skills for scaffold, ADK code, eval, deploy, publish, and observability.
limitations: It relies on google-agents-cli and uv being installed when commands must run.
It points to companion skills for detailed ADK API and deployment instructions.
Deployment and publishing still require configured Google Cloud credentials and human approval.
Current model availability must be checked from live Google documentation or CLI output.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Agent
use_cases.description: Collect requirements, safety constraints, data sources, and deployment preferences before scaffolding an ADK project.
use_cases.target_user: Product engineers starting an ADK agent project

use_cases.title: Standardize Agent Delivery
use_cases.description: Use one workflow for scaffolding, code changes, smoke tests, evals, deployment, and production observation.
use_cases.target_user: Platform teams supporting multiple agent builders

use_cases.title: Improve Existing Agents
use_cases.description: Enhance an existing codebase with agents-cli structure, evaluation loops, and deployment guidance.
use_cases.target_user: Developers maintaining ADK or Google Cloud agent projects

prompt_templates.title: Plan an ADK Agent
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new project
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Google agents-cli workflow to help me plan a new ADK agent. Ask the required questions and draft the spec after I answer.

prompt_templates.title: Scaffold a Project
prompt_templates.scenario: Create or enhance an agent project
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the agents-cli workflow to decide whether to create a new project or enhance this repository. Preserve existing code and explain each step.

prompt_templates.title: Add Evaluation Coverage
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the agents-cli evaluation workflow to design a small eval set, run the eval loop, and identify fixes before expanding coverage.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Deployment
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the agents-cli workflow to prepare this agent for deployment, publishing, and observability. Include approval points and environment requirements.

output_examples.input: I need a customer support agent that searches internal documents and can later run on Google Cloud.
output: A requirements checklist covering purpose, data sources, safety rules, and deployment preference.
A recommended scaffold path for a retrieval agent with datastore selection.
Next steps for reference sample review, project creation, and first smoke test.

output_examples.input: My ADK agent runs locally, but I need a better validation process before deployment.
output: A small initial eval plan focused on the core user journeys.
Guidance to use agent behavior evals instead of brittle response-content unit tests.
An iteration plan that fixes failures before adding edge cases.

output_examples.input: We want to deploy an existing agents-cli project and register it for Gemini Enterprise.
output: A deployment readiness checklist that includes explicit human approval.
Direction to the deployment and publishing companion skills for target-specific steps.
Observation tasks for traces, logs, and post-release monitoring.

best_practices: Confirm requirements and write a spec before scaffolding or changing code.
Use agents-cli evals for agent behavior and reserve unit tests for deterministic code behavior.
Preserve existing model, version, API key, and environment settings unless the user requests a change.
anti_patterns: Skipping scaffold or enhancement steps and building project structure manually.
Deploying an agent without explicit human approval and passing eval results.
Changing model versions based on memory instead of checking current Google model sources.

faq.question: What does this skill help me build?
faq.answer: It helps coding agents build, test, deploy, publish, and observe Google ADK agents with agents-cli.

faq.question: Does it include detailed ADK API examples?
faq.answer: No. It routes detailed ADK coding questions to the companion ADK code skill.

faq.question: Can it work with an existing agent project?
faq.answer: Yes. It directs agents to enhance existing repositories with agents-cli structure instead of overwriting code.

faq.question: Does it run deployments automatically?
faq.answer: No. The workflow states that deployment requires explicit human approval.

faq.question: How does it handle evaluation?
faq.answer: It prioritizes agents-cli evals for behavior validation and avoids brittle tests that assert exact LLM wording.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
